#!/bin/bash
set +e
CURRENT_HOSTNAME=$(cat /etc/hostname | tr -d " \t\n\r")

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_hostname 'o'\''brien'
else
  echo 'o'\''brien' >/etc/hostname
  sed -i "s/127.0.1.1.*$CURRENT_HOSTNAME/127.0.1.1\to'\''brien/g" /etc/hosts
fi

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom enable_ssh
else
  systemctl enable ssh
fi

sed -i 's/^#*PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

FIRSTUSERHOME=$(getent passwd 'pi' | cut -d: -f6)
if [ -z "$FIRSTUSERHOME" ]; then FIRSTUSERHOME="/home/pi"; fi
mkdir -p "$FIRSTUSERHOME/.ssh"
chmod 700 "$FIRSTUSERHOME/.ssh"
cat >> "$FIRSTUSERHOME/.ssh/authorized_keys" <<'SSHEOF'
ssh-ed25519 AAAA one
SSHEOF
chmod 600 "$FIRSTUSERHOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chown -R 'pi:pi' "$FIRSTUSERHOME/.ssh"

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_wlan 'Legacy'\''s' 'pw'\''1' 'IE'
else
  cat > '/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/wifi-0.nmconnection' <<'NMEOF'
[connection]
id=Legacy's
type=wifi
autoconnect-priority=0
[wifi]
mode=infrastructure
ssid=Legacy's
[wifi-security]
auth-alg=open
key-mgmt=wpa-psk
psk=pw'1
[ipv4]
method=auto
[ipv6]
method=auto
NMEOF
  chmod 600 '/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/wifi-0.nmconnection'
fi

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_timezone 'Europe/Dublin'
else
  rm -f /etc/localtime
  echo 'Europe/Dublin' >/etc/timezone
  dpkg-reconfigure -f noninteractive tzdata
fi

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_keymap 'gb' 'gb'
fi

# BenchBob: our apt source and key, installed from it once the network is up
mkdir -p /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
cat > '/usr/share/keyrings/benchbob-archive-keyring.asc' << 'BBKEYEOF'
-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----

mDMEatbqHRYJKwYBBAHaRw8BAQdA3JLZ+2WxZVycHk7FEsffmteEFoxm4eoHYkQi
F74Tabu0M0JlbmNoQm9iIEFyY2hpdmUgU2lnbmluZyBLZXkgPGNhbWVyb25AdGFj
a2xpbmQuY29tPoiTBBMWCgA7FiEEaZEj/wPWhSvnMr2j6WNdcQ4wjZMFAmrW6h0C
GwMFCwkIBwICIgIGFQoJCAsCBBYCAwECHgcCF4AACgkQ6WNdcQ4wjZM4bwD+P8HK
E1Tjois8QZ6Fk6mExOdbV89K1MR+FfbfhauOZ0YA/jVj28Ft0SXaNhtQKWk8T9ZV
1x+Tdp43Nxp5MjYCJ7UD
=771v
-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----
BBKEYEOF
cat > '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/benchbob-bootstrap.sources' << 'BBSRCEOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://cinderblock.github.io/BenchBob/apt
Suites: stable
Components: main
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/benchbob-archive-keyring.asc
BBSRCEOF
cat > '/etc/systemd/system/benchbob-firstboot.service' << 'BBUNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Install BenchBob (first boot)
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=!/usr/lib/benchbob/VERSION

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Check-Date off: the clock may not have synced yet, and apt would call the repo "not valid yet".
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'apt-get -o Acquire::Check-Date=false update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold benchbob'
ExecStartPost=/bin/systemctl disable benchbob-firstboot.service
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=60

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
BBUNITEOF
systemctl enable benchbob-firstboot.service

rm -f /boot/firmware/firstrun.sh
sed -i 's| systemd.run.*||g' /boot/firmware/cmdline.txt
exit 0
console=tty1 root=PARTUUID=abcd-02 rootwait systemd.run=/boot/firmware/firstrun.sh systemd.run_success_action=reboot systemd.unit=kernel-command-line.target
